chapter_mission: Ben and Inspector Cale Dorrin cross-reference the fragment’s surviving GAG audit/handler marker against Elya’s old assignment logs, supervision records, and postwar prosecution files. Dorrin discovers that Talon Veyr worked under Elya in the records/logistics environment after Maro Tess reassigned him out of field duty, and that Talon’s later transfer-chain conviction involved manifest/authorization patterns close to the recovered fragment. Ben identifies Talon as the person likely to recognize the shipment fraud pattern, not as a magic decoder. Ben tries the legal route first, using Dorrin’s lawful access and Luke’s quiet support rather than a prison break.
